item.title: Two Texas Tech inventors named to National Academy of Inventors Senior Members
item.description: Texas Tech University's Gerardo Gamez and Dy Dinh Le have been named to the 2026 class of National Academy of Inventors (NAI) Senior Members. They will be inducted at the 15 Annual NAI Conference taking place June 1 through 4 in Los Angeles.
